essence: Devotees are compared by their objects of worship.
Devotees with unfeigned absorption in the Lord are declared most united.
Devotees of the unmanifest Brahman are set apart from those of the formed.
Such devotees attain the Lord alone.
Worship of the unmanifest is harder because it requires attributing qualities and greater effort.
